### Balance, Part Two
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/today-s-insight-january-17-2018.html
Passage: 1 Kings 9:3-5
Points:
- Prosperity often poses a far greater challenge to spiritual equilibrium than adversity.
- King David serves as an example of handling immense power and wealth with integrity of heart.
- Genuine integrity means being verbally trustworthy, financially dependable, and morally pure.
- Achieving success never gives anyone permission to compromise or call wrong right.
- Maintaining spiritual balance at great heights demands unwavering personal integrity.
